'in_stack_00000004[1].base.actor_name + 0x18' walks 1 x sizeof(CCharacter) (0xc1d0) + offsetof(base.actor_name) (0x0) + 0x18 = 0xc1e8, which is exactly offsetof(CEnemy, victim). Ghidra had no CEnemy type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CEnemy *)in_stack_00000004)->victim (§de-pun/§12). Ambiguous: CMooCow::part_indices[3] also has a field there — confirm the real class from the .asm before rewriting.
